decision.rationale: The supplied UUID has no registered session. Documentation and an exact empty-session test require 400; the checker’s structural-validity oracle overlooks this state precondition despite a documented 400 response.

scope.tests_and_docs: Package-local test directories, README/API prose and linked DTO/service/serialization files only.

manual_fallback.notes: Source route, exact observed scenario, independent test/doc candidates and competing branches were inspected; accepted additions are listed separately. The time-matched controller log at K03/r1/compose.log:531 states that the registration token does not exist (08:48:57.344, immediately before captured response timestamp 08:48:57.347553).

coverage_resolution: Manual handler and field review supplements the lexical scan.
